exports.name: Container
exports.summary:
用于承载其它任何组件，容器负责一些基础性的行为，也就是装载子项、添加、插入和移除子项。
根据容纳子项的不同，所产生的可视效果，需委托任意布局类layout中的一种来指点特定的布局逻辑（layout logic）。
此类被于继承而且一般情况下不应通过关键字new来直接实例化。
 xtype container

methods.name: insert
methods.description:
把插件(Component)插入到容器指定的位置（按索引）。执行插入之前触发beforeadd事件，插入完毕触发add事件
 组件插入到容器collection集合的索引
 欲加入的组件

properties.name: items
properties.description:
一个单独项，或子组件组成的数组，加入到此容器中。每一项的对象类型是基于dui.
Component可传入一个组件的配置对象即是lazy-rendering的做法，
这样做的好处是组件不会立即渲染，减低直接构建组件对象带来的开销。
要发挥"lazy instantiation延时初始化"的特性，应对组件所属的登记类型的dui.Componentxtype属性进行配置。

properties.name: autoDestroy
properties.description:
cfg {boolean} autoDestroy
若为true容器会自动销毁容器下面全部的组件，否则的话必须手动执行销毁过程（默认为true）。

exports.name: ExpansionPanel
exports.summary:
<expansion-panel> component.

This component can be used as a single element to show expandable content, or as one of
multiple children of an element with the MdAccordion directive attached.

Please refer to README.md for examples on how to use it.

inputs.name: hideToggle
inputs.description: Whether the toggle indicator should be hidden.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description:
label?: string
Sets label of [ExpansionPanelComponent] header.
Defaults to 'Click to expand'

inputs.name: description
inputs.description:
sublabel?: string
Sets sublabel of [ExpansionPanelComponent] header.

outputs.name: closed
outputs.description: Event emitted every time the AccordionItem is closed.

outputs.name: opened
outputs.description: Event emitted every time the AccordionItem is opened.

outputs.name: destroyed
outputs.description: Event emitted when the AccordionItem is destroyed.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the expanded state of the accordion item.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Sets the expanded state of the accordion item to false.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Sets the expanded state of the accordion item to true.
